sentences.text:
Polisetty Radha vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 24 July,
2020
Author: M.Ganga Rao

entities.text: Polisetty Radha vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Bench: M.Ganga Rao
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Ganga Rao
 Criminal Petition No.2813 Of 2020
Order:

-
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 read with 457 Cr.P.C seeking a direction to the learned Additional Junior Civil Judge, Macherla, Guntur District to pass orders on the petition pertaining to e-filing No.AP/6/CRLMP/11011/16-6-2020 and consequently, direct the learned Judge to release the vehicle - Mahindra Bolero Truck bearing registration No.AP 27 TT 4114.
2.

entities.text: Additional Junior Civil Judge, Macherla, Guntur District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.

3. Case of the prosecution is that on the ground that the accused were transporting gutka packets in the aforementioned vehicle on 26.5.2020, at about 8:30 hours, at the border check post, T Junction,
on Macharla and Hyderabad National Highway in Nagarjunasagar Police limits, Macharla Mandal,
respondent No.2 police registered a case in Crime No.97 of 2020 for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 273, 420 and 328 read with 34 I.P.C. and Sections 57(1), 58 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner contended that for release of the aforesaid vehicle, the petitioner filed petition vide e-filing No.AP/6/CRLMP/11011/16-6-2020 but due to Covid-19 pandemic situation, the learned Judge is not disposing of the said petition and hence, prays to give a direction to the learned Judge to dispose of the said petition expeditiously.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and on perusal of the material available on record, in the interest of justice, this Criminal Petition is disposed of directing the learned Additional Junior Civil Judge, Macherla, Guntur District to dispose of the petition pertaining to e-filing No.AP/6/CRLMP/11011/16-6- 2020 filed for release of the vehicle - Mahindra Bolero Truck bearing registration No.AP 27 TT 4114, as expeditiously as possible, in accordance with law, and communicate the decision taken to the petitioner.

entities.text: Additional Junior Civil Judge, Macherla, Guntur District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
